project_info.theme: Techcombank Nha Trang food discovery map with vouchers
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, white, black, bright red, warm food tones

main_subject.detail: A location-guide poster themed like a discovery map for Nha Trang. The main headline reads 'QUAN NGON PHAI THU TAI NHA TRANG' with supporting text 'Nhung cua hang noi bat tren Ban do Kham pha Viet Nam ruc ro'. Five pinned polaroid-style food photos are arranged across a blue map grid. The food spot names are 'LA COFFEE', 'COM TAM HONG SINCE 2003', 'TIEM MI QUANG NAM', 'NHA HANG AN VIET THON', and 'NHA HANG THUY 66'. Red ticket graphics float around with voucher values '500,000VND', '100,000VND', and '250,000VND'. The bottom shows a waterfront Nha Trang skyline collage.
main_subject.style: Travel-guide infographic poster with pinned snapshot cards, map markers, and bright tourism merchandising

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Techcombank Nha Trang food discovery map with vouchers. Centerpiece is a blue map-grid layout filled with five pinned polaroid-style restaurant and drink photos labeled 'LA COFFEE', 'COM TAM HONG SINCE 2003', 'TIEM MI QUANG NAM', 'NHA HANG AN VIET THON', and 'NHA HANG THUY 66'. Background is a bright sky and a Nha Trang waterfront skyline collage at the bottom. Surrounding elements: Techcombank logo, exact headline 'QUAN NGON PHAI THU TAI NHA TRANG', supporting copy 'Nhung cua hang noi bat tren Ban do Kham pha Viet Nam ruc ro', large red location pins, floating torn voucher tickets '500,000VND', '100,000VND', and '250,000VND', plus the bottom-left line 'VUOT TROI MOI NGAY'. Technical style: photo-collage infographic poster with travel map compositing, bright daytime travel-commercial lighting, sunny sky glow and soft drop shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
